mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate level directly reflects monetary policy tightness; higher rates increase discount rates applied to equity cash flows, compressing valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS level on 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The combined effect of high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) and tight monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%) creates dual economic stress that depresses corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% AND FEDFUNDS > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (RSAFS > 500,000 million dollars and UNRATE < 4.0%), strong consumer spending and tight labor markets signal approaching economic peak, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate earnings slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS > 500000 AND UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 (index) signals weakening manufacturing output, reducing corporate revenue growth and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) and housing starts (HOUST < 1200.0) indicate broad economic contraction across manufacturing and construction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0 AND HOUST < 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 19500 billion dollars) signals robust corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors price in sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when GDPC1 > 19500.

mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate level continuously influences equity discount rates; higher rates consistently depress S&P 500 valuations, causing negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS level on 60-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
